product_one_liner.value: Lob provides businesses’ marketing and operations teams with a platform and APIs to automate, personalize, route, print, deliver, and track direct-mail campaigns at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: Lob’s homepage describes automated direct mail, data-driven personalization, and printing, routing, and delivery; it identifies the offering as serving teams managing complex direct mail at scale.

pricing_page.notes: The public Lob pricing page lists Developer, Startup, Growth, and Enterprise tiers, including prices and a comparison section.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Lob’s customer stories page names 120Water and Housecall Pro as customer case studies. | named_customers.0: The Lob customer stories page has a named 120Water case study. | named_customers.1: The Lob customer stories page has a named Housecall Pro case study.

employee_band.notes: Lob’s LinkedIn company profile gives its employee-size band as 201–500.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile states that Lob is headquartered in San Francisco, United States; the requested city is San Francisco. | hq_country: The Lob company profile explicitly identifies its headquarters as San Francisco, United States.

founded_year.notes: Lob’s LinkedIn company profile states Founded 2013, and the company job posting also says Lob was founded in 2013.

eng_blog.notes: Lob’s Engineering blog index lists multiple technical build posts, including posts on creating SDKs with OpenAPI and migrating its services to Nomad, with named authors; this exceeds the two-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: Lob’s public Help Center index lists numerous developer guides and integration articles, and the API quickstart is an accessible multi-section documentation page.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Greenhouse job board lists five openings; their titles are Enterprise Account Executive, Business Operations Manager, Corporate Counsel, Partner Operations Manager, and Senior Manager, USPS Programs, none of which is an AI/ML or data-science role title.

model_provider.value: Lob says its address-parsing deep-learning models are trained in-house and identifies spaCy as the library used for its address parser; it does not name a third-party LLM provider.
model_provider.notes: Lob’s technical posts say it trains in-house deep-learning models for address parsing and chose spaCy for the address parser. These sources identify Lob’s own model development and its parser library, not a third-party LLM provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Lob’s Trust Center explicitly lists SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR under Compliance; these are the named items from the requested set. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center names SOC 2 Type 2 compliance. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center names HIPAA compliance and its HIPAA-related processes and audit. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center explicitly names GDPR among applicable regulations.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest disclosed funding profile calls the latest round Series C; Lob’s own funding announcement also names it as Series C. | funding_date: The source identifies the latest disclosed Series C as occurring on February 25, 2021; the schema requests YYYY-MM, so this is normalized to 2021-02. | funding_amount_usd: The latest-disclosed-round profile updated in November 2026 reports approximately $50 million for the Series C, and Lob’s own announcement confirms the $50 million Series C financing.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly disclosed round is the Series C in February 2021, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Lob’s live Greenhouse board lists an Enterprise Account Executive opening, which matches the requested hiring titles.

launched_6mo.notes: Lob announced its No-Code Design Suite on August 31, 2026, a major product feature within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Lob announced senior executive appointments on November 12, 2025, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026; the announcement identifies C-level appointments.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Lob’s current subprocessor list identifies Marketo and Mutiny as customer sales lead-management providers and Mailchimp as an email marketing provider. | crm_stack_signal.0: Lob’s subprocessor list names Marketo as a customer sales lead-management provider. | crm_stack_signal.1: Lob’s subprocessor list names Mutiny as a customer sales lead-management provider. | crm_stack_signal.2: Lob’s subprocessor list names Mailchimp as an email marketing provider.
